title: Update Gen 4/5 Mgp licence format and UI text

requirements.summary: Update Mgp validation to require exact "Mgp-" prefix followed by alphanumeric characters and align error messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts, validateMgpId returns true for values like "Mgp-1", "Mgp-ABC", "Mgp-a1B2".
validateMgpId returns false for values like "mgp-123" (wrong case), "MGP-123" (wrong case), "Mgp-" (missing suffix), "Mgp-12_3" (underscore not allowed), and "Mgp 123" (missing hyphen).
getMgpErrorMessage reflects the updated rule (prefix "Mgp-" + letters/numbers) and no longer mentions "mgp-" or "digits only".

file_operations.description: Update validateMgpId to enforce the exact required format: prefix "Mgp-" followed by one or more alphanumeric characters only, and update getMgpErrorMessage strings to say "Mgp licence" and describe the new rule ("Mgp-" + letters/numbers).

requirements.summary: Update Gen 4 ELC options Mgp entry dialog copy to say "Mgp licence" and display the exact required "Mgp-" format in all user-facing text.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx, the dialog title/description/label text uses "Mgp licence" (English) rather than "Mgp ID".
The input placeholder/example shown to the user uses "Mgp-" (e.g., "Mgp-ABC123"), matching the new validation rule.
Submitting an invalid value shows the updated error message from getMgpErrorMessage.

file_operations.description: Revise Gen 4 Racer Mgp dialog and related UI copy to use "Mgp licence" (title/description/label/helper text/button text where applicable) and update placeholder/example to "Mgp-ABC123". Ensure invalid submissions continue to use getMgpErrorMessage for the displayed error. Use the existing shadcn/ui Dialog, Input, Label, and Button components already in this file to present the entry UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
